pranav: quick async standup — kernel & batching run
what I did: landed LRU eviction for KV cache; added safe-evict flag to kernel; ran 1k-token perf sweep on g5. Blockers: microbatch scheduling causing head-of-line latency spikes when sequence lengths vary; seeing ~12% tail latency increase on p99 for short requests. Need help validating batching heuristics.
Today: instrument batching decisions, run real workload perf tests, open PR for scheduling logic
cc @morgan for review, @elaine I tagged you on telemetry PR

elaine: saw the telemetry tag — will review tonight. For p99 can you paste the flame graph? :eyes:

morgan: pinged on the PR, left comments about race on cache invalidation. I think the safe-evict flag needs a backoff. Also re: batching, did you try forcing single-batch path to compare?

pranav: yes ran single-batch baseline — perf: 11ms median, 88ms p99; with microbatching: 9ms med, 98ms p99. attaching sample trace below.

pranav: ```
# sample trace snippet
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] request_id=abc123 seq=1 batch_size=4 kernel=matmul_fast kv_hit=true
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] kernel_dispatch latency=2.1ms
[2026-03-16T22:14:03Z] wait_for_batch latency=15.2ms
```

sam: CI ran on your branch — tests passed but flakiness on `serving/batching_test.py::test_variable_lengths` 2/5. CI log:

sam: ```
E       AssertionError: expected no head-of-line block
logs: wait_for_batch 14.9ms -> 150ms
```

ci-bot: pipeline/pr-482 merged to staging by auto-squash :rocket:

elaine: if flakiness persists try capping batch window to 6ms. Also let's add a flag to replicate old scheduling for canary.

morgan: I can help repro locally tomorrow. Can you push a minimal repro harness? If not, I can instrument in prod staging for 30m.

pranav: will push a repro harness + perf script this afternoon. Also adding a canary config to allow old scheduling. Thanks all :ty:

sam: noted. If you need quick help with the flamegraph tooling ping me — I can run perf on a dedicated slot.

pranav: thanks — filing follow-ups: PR 482 (eviction), issue 2104 (batch-scheduling), canary tag 'sched-old' — will update here when stamps are up.

morgan: :+1:

pranav: last message — small reminder: perf benchmark numbers attached to PR are synthetic; I'll run a 24h mixed workload overnight and post real numbers in the morning.
